brand._note: Store identity for this build. The app is a client-facing white-label product: a client fork edits ONLY this file (and its design-tokens brand file) — no code changes, no fork of the app. slug/scheme must be lowercase-hyphen; xcodeName must equal displayName with every non-alphanumeric removed (Expo derives the iOS workspace/scheme/target that way); backgroundColor should match the design-tokens mobile background.
brand._shortNameNote: Short brand token for in-app copy. i18n strings use {{brandFull}} (= app.displayName, e.g. login title) and {{brand}} (= this, inline: 'Consult {{brand}}', '{{brand}} Wallet'). A client reskin sets this to its own short name so no 'AISHA' literal survives in the UI.
brand._gatewayPinnedNote: false = umbrella build: the user may switch instance/gateway at runtime in Settings (default, one app serving many clients). true = dedicated company build: the gateway baked in EXPO_PUBLIC_AISHA_GATEWAY_URL is fixed, the Settings switcher is hidden, and the stored-override path is ignored.

changes: App identity must be explicit: app.config throws when version.json is unreadable or incomplete instead of silently building a mis-identified app
Firebase config paths are env-overridable (AISHA_FIREBASE_IOS_FILE / AISHA_FIREBASE_ANDROID_FILE) for white-label builds
Android joins push: googleServicesFile wired for FCM (previously iOS-only)
Fix: Keycloak login in release builds — KC authority/realm/client vars now reach the runtime via app.config extra
Keycloak authority now fails loud when unconfigured instead of silently degrading to a relative URL
Sentry symbolication by design: JS source maps + dSYMs uploaded to self-hosted Sentry on every build
Editorial ember-orange rebrand: new splash screen, app icon and launcher art
